data.action: 立于月光之下回眸展现罕见的温柔微笑
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 月下神性微笑】大战初歇的第3新东京市残垣断壁之上，巨大的清冷圆月如银盘悬挂于浩瀚夜空。绫波丽身着染尘的白色战斗服，头戴神经接头发夹，伫立于月色之下。在少年的注视下，她那从未展露过情感的白皙面庞上，缓缓浮现出一抹惊艳天地的温柔微笑——「不知道该露出什么表情吗？我想，只要微笑就可以了。」
data.lighting: 皎洁银白月光与冷冽夜色轮廓光
data.location: 第3新东京市战后废墟断崖
data.promptProse: Rei stands among the ruined walls of Tokyo-3 after the battle, her white plugsuit dusty around its orange-and-black panels. Beneath red neural-interface clips, her blue-haired face slowly softens into a gentle smile toward the watching boy. The low medium view places broken masonry beneath her and a large moon beyond. Silver moonlight defines her hair and suit edges, with cool reflected brightness across the shaded rubble.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 月下神性微笑
